compute_diou_loss: compute the DIoU loss between predicted and ground truth bounding boxes in XYXY format
compute_ciou_loss: compute the CIoU loss between predicted and ground truth bounding boxes with aspect ratio penalty
compare_diou_ciou_loss: compare DIoU and CIoU loss values for the same set of predicted and ground truth boxes
batch_diou_loss: compute DIoU loss for a batch of bounding boxes with mean reduction
batch_ciou_loss: compute CIoU loss for a batch of bounding boxes with sum reduction
